entityName: SIQ (Slovenian Institute for quality and metrology)
description:
SIQ is a professional, independent, and impartial institution that provides comprehensive solutions in the fields of product testing and certification, management system assessment, metrology, and education. The international recognition and professional level of our work are confirmed by numerous accreditations and memberships in international certification schemes and associations. We are a notified body for seven directives and two regulations. Our team consists of 184 employees and over 350 external expert collaborators, ensuring a high level of expertise and competence in standardization, inspection, testing, control, and verification. 
The entire list of accreditations and technical competences can be found on following link: https://www.siq.si/en/about-us/competences/

We actively conduct testing and compliance assessments for products and components across various industries, including automotive, medical, electronics, machinery, and laboratory and measurement equipment. More than 100 highly qualified testing engineers perform daily tests in electrical safety, electromagnetic compatibility, radio measurements, and climatic/mechanical impacts. Within our accredited scope, we cover more than 500 different standards and are part of international certification schemes, meaning our reports have global recognition. In terms of the number of issued international certificates, we rank in the top quarter of testing laboratories worldwide.
(https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/testing-and-certification-of-products/about-us/)

We conduct assessments and certifications of processes, organizations, and companies according to various international ISO standards. We cover a wide range of areas, including quality management systems (ISO 9001, AQAP), information security management systems (ISO 27001, ISO 22301), environmental management (ISO 14001), energy management systems (ISO 50001), and more. SIQ is an accredited body for management system certification and carbon footprint verification. Our certification portfolio also includes NATO AQAP standards for quality management. (https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/organization-certification/about-us/)

Additionally, in our offering there are also calibration services for various measuring equipment, ranging from simple scales and gauges to voltage/current meters and complex high-frequency devices for measuring radio interference and electromagnetic waves. Our department also engages in strong research activities, focusing on the development of new measurement methods and procedures, and we regularly participate in European development projects. (https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/calibration-and-inspection/about-us/)

As a hub of expertise and competencies, we have established a training department that provides professional education, competence development, and training in various technical fields. We offer specialized training programs in information security, quality management, and management systems. (https://www.siq.si/en/training/about-us/)

In our scope we also provide cybersecurity services, including penetration testing, security assessments of networks, applications, and systems, as well as audit reviews and compliance assessments based on various standards and regulations. Within our accredited scope, we conduct security evaluations of connected (IoT) devices.
(https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/information-technologies/overview/)

Furthermore, we have a dedicated department for testing and verifying equipment intended for installation in potentially explosive environments, ensuring compliance with European regulations. (https://www.siq.si/en/our-services/explosion-protection/about-us/)

entityDescription:
AndroMach is a pioneering French aerospace company developing autonomous spaceplanes to enable in-orbit manufacturing and advanced research in microgravity. Our mission is to provide a cost-effective and reusable platform for producing high-value materials in space while accelerating access to microgravity for scientific and industrial applications. 
Our flagship product is an automated orbital shuttle (100kg payload), designed to serve as a fully reusable in-space manufacturing platform. This vehicle will enable the production of high-value-added materials in LEO and return them to Earth efficiently. By leveraging automation and reusability, we aim to revolutionize space-based production, unlocking new opportunities in medicine and advanced materials manufacturing.
To pave the way for this vision, AndroMach is developing a suborbital demonstrator that will validate key technologies required for the orbital shuttle. This vehicle will be capable of taking off and landing on a runway while offering a phase of microgravity (5min), a capability never before realized. The demonstrator will serve as a testbed for flight systems, aerodynamics, and propulsion, while also offering commercial opportunities for short-duration microgravity experiments and aerospace technology validation (10-30kg payload).

Deep Breathe is an advanced AI-driven medical diagnostics organization specializing in automated screening and early detection of serious respiratory conditions. Our technology is designed to enhance clinical decision-making by leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms to analyze medical imaging and other diagnostic inputs with high accuracy and efficiency.
In the context of space exploration and long-term human inhabitation of extraterrestrial environments, Deep Breathe plays a crucial role in addressing respiratory health risks unique to aerospace conditions. Our research and technological solutions are particularly relevant to:
Pulmonary effects of celestial dust exposure: Astronauts and space inhabitants are at risk of lung inflammation and fibrosis due to prolonged exposure to fine dust particles on planetary surfaces such as the Moon and Mars. Deep Breathe’s AI-driven screening tools can detect early signs of dust-induced pneumoconiosis and fibrosis, enabling timely interventions.

Pneumothorax risk from barometric pressure changes: Rapid decompression events and extended exposure to microgravity environments pose a heightened risk of lung collapse (pneumothorax), particularly during extravehicular activities (EVA) or pressurized cabin failures. Our AI diagnostic models are trained to recognize subtle radiological markers associated with pneumothorax, ensuring real-time risk assessment and early intervention protocols.

Pneumonia and respiratory infections in space habitats: As humans venture into long-duration spaceflight and planetary colonies, the potential for infectious respiratory conditions increases due to altered immunity, closed-loop life support systems, and microbial changes in space environments. Deep Breathe’s automated diagnostic systems enhance early pneumonia detection through imaging and biosensor data, supporting efficient onboard medical treatment strategies.

Deep Breathe’s AI-driven solutions offer a non-invasive, rapid, and highly scalable method for monitoring and diagnosing aerospace-specific respiratory conditions, providing a critical toolset for space agencies, commercial spaceflight operators, and planetary habitation planners. By integrating our technology into remote and autonomous healthcare solutions for space, we contribute to proactive health management, mission safety, and the long-term sustainability of human space exploration.
As a leader in automated diagnostics for pulmonary health, Deep Breathe aligns with ESA’s objectives to enhance astronaut health, mitigate mission risks, and develop robust medical infrastructures for deep-space missions. Our work represents a fundamental step toward self-sufficient healthcare systems for interplanetary exploration and settlement.

entityDescription:
The Leibniz Centre for Tropical Marine Research (ZMT) is Germany-wide the only and unique research institute for the study of tropical marine ecosystems and their services to human societies.
The mission of ZMT is to provide a scientific basis for the protection and sustainable use of tropical coastal ecosystems by conducting research, capacity development and consulting activities in close cooperation with international and national partners. Those activities are rooted in an impact-oriented inter- and transdisciplinary approach, integrating social and natural sciences.
As one of the first research institutes in Germany, ZMT, from its very beginning in 1991, genuinely brought together the key disciplines for the holistic assessment of marine resource use and management in the tropics. Today, ZMT continues to play a leading role in the integration of social and natural science approaches, as well as transdisciplinary stakeholder involvement processes bridging the science-practice gap.
With its inter- and transdisciplinary approach to the study of tropical coastal systems, ZMT has earned a special position within the German marine research environment and plays a vital role in setting the agenda for coastal science cooperation between Germany and partner countries in the tropics.
The Articles of Association (Gesellschaftsvertrag) lay out the mission of ZMT as follows:
- fundamental scientific research in priority areas of tropical marine ecology and related fields
- scientific assessment of applied projects in the field of tropical marine ecology and related areas
- academic education and training in Germany and tropical countries
- transfer of research results
- provision of expert scientific advice
- advice in particular to the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen and the Federal Government on issues of marine research, especially its expansion and development as well as on matters of scientific cooperation with countries in the tropics
ZMT regards its mission as a great responsibility to conduct excellent research and to sustain its credibility. Its institutional culture is determined by self-responsibility, transparency, respect, reliability and an eye-level communication.
